content.title: Is It Possible for You to Give 30 Crore Taka in Charity Every Day?
content.subtitle: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ showed us a way to earn even greater rewards. Do you know how?
content.body:
Is it possible for even the wealthiest person in the world to donate 30 Crore taka in the way of Allah every day? Just imagining such an amount is overwhelming. Yet, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught his Ummah a simple practice that takes only a few minutes and carries rewards greater than donating millions of taka in charity.

Umm Hani (RA) and Her Plea

According to a Hadith, Umm Hani (RA), the cousin of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, once came to him with a heartfelt request. Burdened by old age, her body had grown weak, and she could no longer stand for long periods of worship as she once did. With a tearful voice, she said, “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I have grown old, and my body has become very weak. Please teach me an easy act of worship that I can perform while sitting in one place.”

The Reward of Donating 100 Fully Equipped Warhorses

In response, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Recite ‘SubhanAllah’ 100 times. It will bring you a reward equivalent to donating 100 warhorses, fully equipped with saddles and bridles, in the way of Allah.”

Considering the present-day price of 100 high-quality horses suitable for war or transportation, their value could easily amount to millions of taka. Yet, by reciting “SubhanAllah” for just a few minutes, Allah can record an equivalent reward in a believer’s book of deeds.

The Reward of Sacrificing 100 Camels and Freeing 100 Slaves

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, “Recite ‘Alhamdulillah’ 100 times; it is better than sacrificing 100 accepted camels for the sake of Allah.”

Just imagine the current market value of 100 high-quality camels. The cost of such a large herd represents an enormous amount of charity!

The Prophet ﷺ further said, “Recite ‘Allahu Akbar’ 100 times; it carries the reward of freeing 100 slaves from among the descendants of Ismail (AS).”

Regarding the emancipation of slaves, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Whoever frees a Muslim slave, Allah will save every part of the person who freed him from the Fire of Hell in exchange for every part of the slave—even his private parts will be saved in exchange for the slave’s private parts.”

Now, consider how great a deed it is to purchase a captive person and set them free!

Filling All the Space Between the Heavens and the Earth

Finally, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Recite ‘La ilaha illallah’ 100 times. The reward of this remembrance fills all the space between the heavens and the earth.”

If we calculate the present-day monetary value of 100 horses, 100 camels, and freeing 100 slaves, it could easily exceed 20-30 Crore taka. Yet, by spending just five to ten minutes every morning and evening reciting these words of remembrance, Allah may grant you an immense reward in your book of deeds, In Sha Allah.

Will we still remain idle? Will we continue complaining that Allah has not granted us the ability to give charity?
